To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
HgCdTe can be grown on Si substrates with extremely high compositional uniformities, low defect densities, and high operability.

we have demonstrated the capability to grow high-quality, large-area HgCdTe single- and two-layer heterojunctions on both 6 inch Si and 8 cm × 8 cm CdZnTe with extremely high compositional uniformities and low defect densities, and we have fabricated and characterized large-format FPAs that demonstrate high operability and very low cluster outages.

we have demonstrated the ability to grow high quality HgCdTe epitaxial layers on large area (6 inch diameter) Si and (8 cm x 8 cm) CdZnTe wafers, and that we have fabricated single- and two color FPAs with high operability and uniformly low defect density.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of large-area (4–6 in. on Si, 4 cm × 4 cm to >8 cm × 8 cm on (211)B CdZnTe) molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) growth of HgCdT e on Si and CdZ nTe substrates.
the development of a new generation of high-performance, low-cost infrared detectors for the 1.5 to 5.5  μ m wavelength range.
the development of high-performance HgCdTe-based focal-plane arrays for infrared (IR) detection in the midwave IR, longwave IR, and shortwave IR spectral regions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the epitaxy process and the epitaxial quality of HgCdTefor both single- and two-layer devices are not the limiting factors for the production of large-format FPAs.
molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) has become an enabling technology for large-area HgCdTe focal-plane arrays.
the growth of HgCdT on large-area Si or CdZnTe is now a routine technology at RVS.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
large-scale MBE growth on Si and CdZTe substrates is now possible without sacrificing the quality and uniformity of the layers.
the epitaxial quality of the 6 inch HgCdTe grown on Si and 8 cm2 on CdZnTE is as good as the quality obtained on 4 inch Si and 4 cm2 CdZnTe.
the growth of large-area HgCdTe epitaxial layers on Si or CdZnTe is now a routine process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
large-area HgCdTe can be grown with extremely uniform composition and low macrodefects on Si and CdZTe, which is critical to achieving high operability and high performance of large-format FPAs.
large-area HgCdTe epitaxial growth on Si and CdZnte substrates is a viable technology for the production of large-format infrared FPAs.
the quality of HgCdT e layers can be maintained at high growth rates and on large substrates, thus allowing us to grow HgCdTe for large FPAs.
